Nine killed in business jet crash in Florida residential area

A business jet carrying nine people crashed in a residential area in Palm Beach, Florida, killing all on board. The incident occurred near a busy roadway and close to former President Donald Trump's Mar-a-Lago estate. The type of jet involved was a Learjet.
